releases.notes:
A lightweight, client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21+ that displays player name history and UUIDs in chat.

## 🎮 Features

- **Simple Commands**: Use `/igns <username>` or `/names <username>` to lookup any player
- **Beautiful Output**: Gradient-colored chat messages with clickable UUIDs
- **Smart Caching**: Reduces API calls with intelligent 1-hour cache system
- **API Fallback**: Automatically switches between Crafty.gg and Mojang APIs
- **Tab Completion**: Suggests online players when typing commands
- **Client-Side**: Works on any server without requiring server-side installation
- **Lightweight**: Minimal resource usage and dependencies

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21 or higher
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0 or higher
- Fabric API 0.102.0 or higher
- Java 21

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download G1axNameHistory from the releases page
4. Place both JARs in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
5. Launch Minecraft with Fabric profile

## 📖 Usage

```
/igns <username>  - Display name history for a player
/names <username> - Alternative command (same functionality)
```

**Example Output:**
```
─────────────────────────────────
G1axNameHistory: Player Info
─────────────────────────────────
Current IGN: ExamplePlayer
UUID: 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012 [Click to copy]

Name History:
  1. ExamplePlayer (Current)
  2. OldName123 (Changed: Jan 15, 2024)
  3. FirstName (Changed: Jun 3, 2023)
─────────────────────────────────
Source: crafty.gg | Cached: ✓
```

## 🏗️ Project Structure

```
G1axNameHistory/
├── src/main/java/com/g1ax/namehistory/
│   ├── G1axNameHistory.java          # Main mod initializer
│   ├── commands/
│   │   └── NameHistoryCommand.java   # Command registration & handling
│   ├── api/
│   │   ├── ApiManager.java           # Async API call manager
│   │   ├── CraftyGGApi.java          # Crafty.gg API implementation
│   │   ├── MojangApi.java            # Mojang API implementation
│   │   └── ApiFallbackHandler.java   # Automatic API fallback
│   ├── cache/
│   │   └── DataCacheManager.java     # LRU cache with TTL
│   ├── utils/
│   │   ├── ColorUtils.java           # Gradient text generation
│   │   ├── UUIDUtils.java            # UUID formatting utilities
│   │   └── TextFormatter.java        # Chat output formatting
│   └── data/
│       └── PlayerData.java           # Player data model
├── src/main/resources/
│   └── fabric.mod.json               # Mod metadata
├── build.gradle                      # Build configuration
└── gradle.properties                 # Project properties
```

## 🔧 Building from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AkaTriggered/G1axNameHistory.git
cd G1axNameHistory
./gradlew build
```

The compiled JAR will be in `build/libs/`
